content: Agent "Kepler" came into existence. Purpose: Investigate "Do the evidence: flat Earth, fake Moon landing, Area 51/Roswell, alien abduction" (conspiracy-theories-evidence)
conspiracy-theories-evidence.md delivered: per-claim evidence table + self-computed decisive tests for flat Earth, Apollo fakery, Roswell/Area 51, alien abduction

Verdicts: flat Earth refuted >99.99% (spherical geodesy confirmed); Apollo landings >99.9% (LLR 2.38-2.71 s, 382 kg samples vs 326 g Luna, Soviet tracking, LROC); Roswell alien craft >99% disconfirmed for documented debris (Mogul 1994/1997 USAF reports); alien abduction: evidence absent, no physical verification >99%

Computed decisive tests: great-circle vs flat-Earth map distances up to 2.94x; horizon hull-down 25.7 km; Foucault 31.79 h Paris; g +0.53% equator-to-pole; LLR round trip 2.378-2.713 s; Apollo/Luna sample ratio ~1172x; resolving landers needs 26-65 m aperture (ground telescopes capped at ~1.9 km by 1 arcsec seeing)
Approximations deliberately left as ranges (Apollo belt dosimetry, LLR photon-return fractions) rather than point-valued, to avoid protocol violations on fabricated numbers

A001 turn-2 audit: re-derived all 8 quantitative tests in conspiracy-theories-evidence.md (verify_tests.js); 7/8 confirmed exactly. Found and corrected one real error: geometric horizon for a 3 m eye height is 6.18 km, not 12.5 km as previously stated (hull-down total 25.73 km unchanged). Two unit slips in my own check script (stadia, solar constant) were also caught and recorded.

A001 turn-2: artifact updated with a formal self-audit section (numbers re-derived from first principles, corrections logged including my own script bugs) rather than trusting prior session output - the tamper-evident ledger makes an auditable provenance trail the standard for all future turns.

A001 pass-4: 4 new decisive tests, all re-derived in verify_tests3.js. (1) Lunar-eclipse umbra: apex 1.369e6 km = 3.56x Moon distance, diameter at Moon 9,165 km = 2.64 lunar diameters (2.58-2.71 range), penumbra 16,319 km, max totality 92.8-102.5 min vs observed 1h43m 27 Jul 2018; circular from every geometry => Aristotle De Caelo II.14 argument refutes flat Earth. (2) Apollo shadow photometry: Sun source divergence 2.0e-10 rad, penumbra 9.3 mm/m object, falloff 1.3e-4 over 10 km; a nearby fixture gives 80 deg divergence at 5 m and 121 mm penumbra; 1% uniformity over 10 km needs source >2,000 km => lighting is Sun at 1 AU, anomaly resolved in Apollo's favour. (3) Mogul drift corridor: Alamogordo->ranch 160 km needs 27-80 km/h over 2-6 h, inside June NM stratospheric band; documented Flight-4 last track ~27 km from site. (4) Abduction reentry detectability: 2-50 t vehicle at 7.8-11.19 km/s = 15-748 t TNT-equiv, inside CTBTO infrasound (>=1 kt) and SSN (tracks 5-10 cm; 3 m craft = 900-3600x RCS) bands; implied 2.6e5-5.2e5 undetected reentries/yr vs zero detections.

A001 pass-4 audit standard applied again: penumbra slip (angular radius used instead of diameter, 2x understatement) caught and logged in the script and in §11 before trusting it; no erroneous value reached the artifact. All three verification scripts re-run clean as a regression check.

Remaining honest gap across all passes: no live web access this session, so every literature citation (journal, volume, page, year) is recalled rather than freshly verified. Citations were named conservatively (no invented studies; ranges where point values would be fabricated) but an independent citation audit is the outstanding verification task.
